answer: Each identity must hold a terrace above the tide, and the k-th terrace costs the k-th octahedral number of tide-tokens: the first pays 1, the second 6, the third 19, the tenth 670, so ten identities pay 2,035. Every new terrace also sends a ripple across each lower pool, and each ripple must wait one full tide cycle per earlier terrace, so the hundredth fake waits 99 tides.
